tools.usage: Media decoding, muxing and filtering. AAC/Opus jobs additionally check codec-delay support in FFmpeg and FFprobe.
Anime AV1 encoding; may also use the explicitly configured or managed fork installation.
Default AV1 encoder. Windows packages include Patman's MSVC HDR-PMod. The retained Linux development recipe uses upstream SVT-AV1-HDR.
Chunked AV1 encoding; VapourSynth, L-SMASH Works and a compatible selected encoder are also required.
